summary: Phase 14B+14C RBAC fix VERIFIED. The hardcoded ADMIN_ROLES=('founder','super_admin') tuple usage in /app/backend/routers/admin_panel.py has been fully replaced with require_permission('<resource>:<verb>') imported from the new shared module /app/backend/utils/rbac.py. All 17 legacy admin_panel.py endpoints now honor the ROLE_PERMISSIONS matrix. Wrote a new focused regression suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter20_rbac_matrix.py (45 parameterised tests covering the exact 7-role × 17-endpoint matrix from review_request). Result: 45/45 PASS (100%). Also re-ran the original suites test_phase14_admin_panel.py + test_phase14b_admin_panel.py (60 tests): 59 PASS / 1 FAIL — the sole failure (test_demo_tenants_seeded) is PRE-EXISTING seed-data drift unrelated to this RBAC PR (it expects demo tenant 'tenant-ent-plus' but only finds 'clinic-harmony-hearing-clinic-271f44' and others). All 6 formerly-red RBAC tests from iteration_19 now pass.

action_items: Optional/low-prio: reseed 'tenant-ent-plus' OR update test_phase14_admin_panel.py::test_demo_tenants_seeded to match current seed fixture (unrelated to RBAC fix; was already failing in iter_19).
critical_code_review_comments: utils/rbac.py is clean: single source of truth for ROLE_PERMISSIONS matrix, exports both has_permission() and require_permission() dependency. Founder + super_admin still bypass at top of require_permission — preserved behavior.

admin_panel.py now imports require_permission from utils.rbac and applies correct resource:verb action to each of the 17 routes (dashboard:read, tenants:read/write/impersonate, subscriptions:read/write, invoices:write, revenue:read, leads:read/write, features:read/write, audit:read). Verb mapping matches matrix intent.

DELETE /tenants/{id} correctly still uses explicit `_is_founder(user)` check (not require_permission) — super_admin's '*:write' wildcard would otherwise grant delete. This is the correct defensive pattern and matches review_request's 'super_admin bypasses everything except DELETE tenant' baseline.

Legacy ADMIN_ROLES constant still lives at admin_panel.py:52 but is now unused by routes (only referenced via the import list from auth). Suggest removing the constant + the `require_roles` import to avoid future regressions where a developer uses it again by habit.
admin_panel_b.py no longer duplicates ROLE_PERMISSIONS — it imports from utils.rbac — good. No drift risk between the two files.
has_permission() correctly handles '*', '*:read', '*:write' wildcards; verb extraction uses action.split(':')[-1] which is fine for all current actions (no nested colons).

success_rate.backend: 100% (45/45 iter20 RBAC matrix tests + 33/33 phase14b RBAC-relevant tests). Combined phase14+14b: 59/60 (98.3%) — sole fail is unrelated seed-data drift.
